Harrowgate Maritime Museum — Visit

The Harrowgate Maritime Museum is at 14 Quay Street, Harrowgate, on the old fish dock.

Admission: adult tickets cost $18.50; children under 12 enter free. Tickets are sold at the door and online.

The guided tour of the lifeboat hall runs daily at 11:00 and lasts 75 minutes.

Our new exhibition, Tidewater: Three Centuries of the Harrowgate Fleet, opens on 14 March 2027.
